## Time.toPeriod() function

Normalizes a period-like value into object form.

**Signature:**

```typescript
function toPeriod(periodLike: PeriodLike): Period;
```

**Returns:**

[Period](./morpho-ts.time.period.md)

A period object with `unit` and `duration`<!-- -->.

## Example


```ts
import { Time } from "@morpho-org/morpho-ts";

const period = Time.toPeriod("d");
// { unit: "d", duration: 1 }
```
